about.title: Will Macomber, owner
paragraphs: One Last Cast Plumbing is Will Macomber's company, based in The Dalles and BBB Accredited.
Local realtors recommend Will for new construction, remodels and the repairs that come up when a home changes hands.
Every job is backed by a 14-month warranty.
